body:
With Thursday Reset

A high-version port of the original "With Thursday" mod by AmarokIce, now supporting Minecraft 1.20.1,1.21.1.

This mod adds 33 KFC-style fast food items and 10 drinks, including burgers, paninis, chicken wings, coffee, juice, and more. Craft a Kitchen Knife and start cooking your own Crazy Thursday feast!

Known Issues:
1. The following items currently have no obtainable source (no crafting recipe):
   
   - Dragon Twister (老北京鸡肉卷)
   - Sauce Box (酱料盒)
2. The following recipes are disabled because they depend on mods that are not yet available for high Minecraft versions:
   - Sundae, Ice Cream Float Coffee, Spicy Squid, Chocolate Sundae — require VanillaRecipe (乐在星期四), which has no high-version release
   - Nine Fruit Juice — requires Pam's HarvestCraft 2 (pamhc2foodcore + pamhc2foodextended), which has no high-version release
